A Very Important Thing (Japanese: 大切ですごいもの A Very Important Thing) is the third chapter of the Pocket Monsters BW: The Heroes of Fire and Thunder manga.

==Plot==
 

==Major events==
With the power of , no-one can stand in the way of N as he defeats the Elite Four and destroys the Pokémon League, however the Champion goes missing.
Shin meets an old man passing by, who is looking for something.
After finding it, they reveal their name and position—Champion of the Pokémon League, Alder.
